toegepas.voor: voordat hy by die regte mens kan uitkom
toegepas.na: voordat dit by die regte mens kan uitkom
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'hy' can be read as the carrier ('iemand') rather than the letter; 'dit' points clearly to the letter.
toegepas.fout: 'hy' can point to 'iemand' (the carrier) as well as to the letter.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dit' points unambiguously to the letter and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: het geweet om daar te kyk
toegepas.na: het geweet dat hulle daar moet kyk
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'geweet om ... te kyk' calques English 'knew to look'; a dat-clause is the natural Afrikaans construction.
toegepas.fout: 'het geweet om daar te kyk' copies English 'knew to look'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The dat-clause is the natural Afrikaans construction and says the same thing.

toegepas.voor: Hulle kon net hoop dat daardie skip gou kom.
toegepas.na: Die seemanne kon net hoop dat daardie skip gou sou kom.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hulle' now points to the next ship's people, who cannot be hoping their own ship comes; the hoping belongs to the seamen who left the letters, and the past needs 'sou kom'.
toegepas.fout: 'Hulle' follows 'Die volgende skip se mense' and so points to the wrong people.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the seamen fixes the pronoun, matches the later back-reference to the seamen at the stone, and 'sou kom' suits the past narrative.

toegepas.rede_vinder: No particular letter has been introduced, so the general statement needs the indefinite article.
toegepas.fout: 'Die brief' refers to a letter that was never introduced.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The indefinite article makes the general statement read naturally, and the protected 'na 'n ver dorp' is untouched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'in dieselfde jare' is wooden; 'in dieselfde tydperk' is the idiomatic way to say the same time.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'in dieselfde tydperk' is the natural expression for overlapping times and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.voor: sakke vol pos tussen stede gery
toegepas.na: sakke vol pos tussen stede vervoer
toegepas.rede_vinder: Transitive 'ry' (to carry a load) is colloquial; 'vervoer' is the standard written verb.
toegepas.fout: Trains do not 'ry' a load; the verb does not fit the action.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vervoer' is the exact verb for carrying goods and is a familiar word at Grade 4.

toegepas.blok: Hoe die nuus by mense uitgekom het
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'drukkers' are printing machines or people; the place where newspapers are printed is a 'drukkery'.
toegepas.fout: 'drukkers' names printing machines or people, not the place where newspapers are printed.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'drukkerye' is the exact word for the place and moves no meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die posstelsel bestaan vandag nog en die stappe
toegepas.na: Die posstelsel bestaan vandag nog, en die stappe
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have a subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die posstelsel bestaan' and 'die stappe het gebly' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'gelos' is colloquial for 'left behind'; 'gelaat' is the standard written form.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'gelos' is plain, natural Afrikaans for a Grade 4 reader; 'gelaat' is only a stiffer synonym.

laat_vaar.voor: het ruiters te perd later die pos
laat_vaar.na: het ruiters later te perd die pos
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Afrikaans puts time before manner (tyd-wyse-plek), so 'later te perd' reads naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'te perd' modifies 'ruiters' as a phrase, so the original order is not wrong and the move is lateral.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The diminutive already says small, so 'klein briefie' is a pleonasm.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'klein briefie' is common, natural Afrikaans and stresses the size; dropping 'klein' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: waar briewe gewag het vir die posman
laat_vaar.na: waar briewe vir die posman gewag het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In a subordinate clause the verb group goes last; the extraposed 'vir die posman' sounds English.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing 'vir die posman' after the verb is accepted, natural Afrikaans and does not make the reader stumble.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoe die nuus by mense uitgekom het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The sentence is in the past, so the time clause needs the past form too.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A present-form verb in a time clause within past narration is normal Afrikaans, so the change is lateral.

laat_vaar.blok: Hoe die nuus by mense uitgekom het
laat_vaar.voor: vertel wat by die huis gebeur.
laat_vaar.na: vertel wat by die huis gebeur het.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The main clause is past tense, so the embedded clause should be past too.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Present tense in the embedded clause is normal Afrikaans and carries ongoing news; 'gebeur het' narrows it to what had already happened.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Attributive 'later' takes the inflected form 'latere', and 'gelaat' is the standard written form of 'gelos'.
na_skrywer.fout: Attributive 'later' should be inflected as 'latere' in the glossary definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The grammar fix is real, but the proposal also swaps 'gelos' for 'gelaat' in a shared definition, which is a rewording only the writer may make.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: 'n Klein papiertjie op 'n brief wat vir sy reis betaal.
vlae.rede: 'wat' grammatically attaches to 'brief', so the definition can read as the letter paying; fixing it cleanly needs a restructure (and 'Klein papiertjie' is a pleonasm) that may touch a shared definition, so a person or writer should decide.
